fact: The Minister of State Property and Land Affairs said the land registry office had set up electronic services (ownership, co-ownership, non-ownership certificates) and a computer system covering all its services, and that the department would move to electronic registration and signatures, with a national real-estate portal linked to state-property systems and a digital map.
title: Tunisie : vers un registre foncier 100 % numérique avec enregistrement et signature électroniques
